summary: Dead Rising entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Dead Rising
entries.definitive_edition: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster for modern play; 2016 remaster/original for exact-history comparison

emulation.notes: Use native Deluxe Remaster; original Xbox 360 hardware only for exact-history comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster on PC/current-generation console

primary.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S
primary.why: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster is the current high-fidelity route, rebuilt in RE Engine with modern presentation and quality-of-life changes. The 2016 remaster or Xbox 360 original should be used separately if exact 2006 mechanics and presentation are the preservation goal.
primary.how_to_play: Use Deluxe Remaster for the main route. Record platform/build, graphics settings, difficulty, timer/save behavior, content/voice changes, DLC/costumes, and whether the 2006 original or 2016 remaster was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Exact original mechanics, voices, achievements, and timing feel
secondary.what_to_play: Use if the archive target is the 2006 original rather than the modernized remaster.
secondary.why: Deluxe Remaster changes presentation and quality-of-life behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record changed presentation, voice/content adjustments, quality-of-life options, and whether original mechanics were compared.

entries.title: Dead Rising 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC for the main campaign, plus Xbox 360 Case Zero and Case West for full story coverage

emulation.emulator: Not required for PC; Xenia only for Xbox-exclusive episodes if hardware is unavailable
emulation.notes: Use native PC for main game; Xbox hardware/backward compatibility for Case Zero/Case West when possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC main campaign plus original Xbox 360 exclusive episodes

primary.version: Current PC release with Case Zero/Case West noted separately
primary.why: The PC route is the best capture path for the main Dead Rising 2 campaign, but the story is not fully represented on PC because Case Zero and Case West are Xbox 360-exclusive standalone episodes. Off the Record is a separate non-canon reinterpretation, not a replacement for Dead Rising 2.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release for the main campaign. Record storefront/build, compatibility/fix state, resolution, controller, co-op state, DLC/costume packs, ending route, and whether Xbox 360 Case Zero/Case West were played separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Dead Rising 2: Case Zero prologue and Dead Rising 2: Case West epilogue
secondary.what_to_play: Play Case Zero before the main campaign and Case West after Ending A if documenting the full Chuck Greene story arc.
secondary.why: These standalone episodes were Xbox 360 exclusive and add story material outside the main PC release.

secondary.what_to_play: Track as a separate entry/route, not as the main Dead Rising 2 campaign.
secondary.why: It changes protagonist and scenario framing.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether Case Zero, Case West, and Off the Record are included or treated separately.
